description: This file defines the LogWrapper class that implements the LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log utility, allowing logs to be routed through a chain of LogNode objects. It manages log message output with optional exception details and supports chaining of log processing nodes.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that wraps Android's native logging utility to implement custom logging chain behavior.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to forward logs to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with optional exception info and forwards it to the next node.
